summary:
Windows-only. On Windows ReadWriteLock acts on SQLite side files that
another local user places beside its database. The fix (PR #834) is
Windows ACL handling. The POSIX side of the same advisory, GHSA-v4x8, is
backported in patches/GHSA-v4x8-3wr5-3wq8.patch. Echo builds and ships
this library for Linux only.
